mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a 3-month decline but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 1% month-over-month, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger conditions are met but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000, the combined signal of a tightening labor market leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger conditions are met but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% during expansion but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 1%), a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 decreases but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
